plugin.note: Use cannonable Chasm of Fire or Brimhaven for normal tasks, Catacombs for shards/totems, and Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting PK risk. Demonbane melee and water spells are effective.

requirements: 70 combat is required for normal Greater demon assignments.
Wilderness locations require accepting player-killing risk.
Karuulm Slayer Dungeon requires stone boots or equivalent heat protection.
mechanics: Greater demons are demons, so demonbane weapons apply.
Current monster pages list Greater demons as weak to water spells.
Wilderness Slayer Cave is both cannonable and multicombat.
Catacombs of Kourend cannot be cannoned but can drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces.

methods.label: Normal cannon task
methods.summary: Use a dwarf multicannon with demonbane melee at Chasm of Fire, Brimhaven Dungeon, Isle of Souls Dungeon, or other cannonable non-Wilderness locations.
recommendedFor: Konar location assignments where cannoning is allowed
steps: Choose a cannonable Greater demon location such as Chasm of Fire for dense spawns or Brimhaven when assigned there.
Place the cannon where it covers the most nearby demons.
Use demonbane melee or strong melee while the cannon supplies extra damage.
Safespot with ranged or magic where the location supports it.
risks: Brimhaven spawns are spread out and are not ideal unless assigned there.
Entrana is not advisable because normal weapons and armour cannot be taken there.

methods.label: Catacombs shards and totems
methods.summary: Use Catacombs of Kourend when ancient shards and dark totem pieces are worth slower cannonless task progress.
steps: Use the Catacombs Greater demon rooms.
Fight with demonbane melee or water spells.
Use available safespots if ranging or maging.
notes: The Catacombs row is multicombat, safespottable, and not cannonable.

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave
methods.summary: Use Wilderness Slayer Cave for fast multicombat cannon tasks only when willing to risk player attacks.
steps: Bring only risk you are willing to lose.
Set up the cannon in the Wilderness Slayer Cave Greater demon area.
Use Viggora's chainmace, Emberlight, or Arclight for direct damage.
Leave immediately if hostile players appear.
risks: The location is level 28 Wilderness and multicombat.

styleOptions.label: Demonbane melee
styleOptions.summary: Emberlight or Arclight are preferred for regular Greater demon kills.

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged weapons from safespots when a location supports it.
